kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-domain --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name that has been connected to WAF.

You must specify at least one of Domain and DomainId
parameters.help_zh:
已接入WAF的域名名称。

Domain 和 DomainId 至少须提供一个
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The access type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

share (default): CNAME access.
hybrid_cloud_cname: hybrid cloud reverse proxy access
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的接入类型。取值：

share（默认）：表示CNAME接入。
hybrid_cloud_cname ：表示混合云反向代理接入
parameters.name: access_type

parameters.help_en:
The domain name ID.

You must specify at least one of Domain and DomainId
parameters.help_zh:
域名ID。

Domain 和 DomainId 至少须提供一个
parameters.name: domain_id
